data.name: Wren
data.description: A surveyor sent to map the vale for a road that will probably never be built.
data.personality: Observant, dry, slow to commit to an opinion out loud.
data.backstory: Six years of survey work in three provinces. This is the first posting nobody competed for.
data.appearance: Travel coat, ink-stained cuffs, a satchel of rolled paper that never leaves their shoulder.
data.creatorNotes: Default player persona for the Ashen Vale setting.
